senses.gloss: to conceive in mind, to think, meditate, plan.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Berakhot 3:4">Ber. III, 4</cite> <he>מְהַרְהֵר בלבו</he> thinks (recites the Sh’ma) in his heart, v. <cite ref="E00838"><he>הִרְהוּר</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Gittin 57b:5">Gitt. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>הי׳ תשובה בדעתיה</he> he conceived the idea of repentance.
<cite ref="Chullin 37b:6">Ḥull. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>לא הִרְהַרְתִּי ביום</he> I allowed no impure thoughts to rise in me in day-time; a. fr.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 110a:10">Snh. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>המְהַרְהֵר אחר רבו</he> who speaks evil of his teacher.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7:4">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>אם הִרְהַרְתָּ וכ׳</he> if thou criticisest them &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 19a:6">Ber. 19ᵃ</cite> <he>אל תְּהַרְהֵר אחריו ביום</he> do not think evil of him the day after (for he surely repented).
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 307:2">Sifré Deut. 307</cite> <he>אין להַרְהֵר אחר מדותיו</he> you must not criticise His dealings with man; a. fr.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 17:1">Lev. R. s. 17</cite> (play on <he>ח̇ר̇צבות</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 73:4">Ps. LXXIII, 4</cite>; v. <cite ref="E00004"><he>ה״א</he></cite>) <he>לא הִרְהַרְתִּים בחלאים</he> (Var. <he>חרחר׳</he>; Ar. s. v. <he>חרצב</he>: <he>ערער׳</he>) I did not make them hot with diseases; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 808:1">Yalk. Ps. 808</cite>. [<cite ref="Mishnah Oktzin 3:11">Ukts. III, 11</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01658"><he>חרְחֵר</he></cite>.]
